_comment: The real knob registry for Transcripted. One entry per tunable setting: the shipped default (verified against the source line in `source`), a search range, how a bench applies it (`apply`), and which objectives it can move. status live = a bench can override it in the shipped app today; bench-only = only a bench path honors it (the app hardcodes it), so a winner means a source change; needs-seam = hardcoded and no bench can move it yet: the climber skips it, and the entry documents where a seam would go. Line numbers drift: re-check `source` before editing.

knobs.title: Parakeet encoder compute units
knobs.risk: Faster encoder on one Mac can mean more heat/battery or a slower first load after a compile-cache miss; ANE vs GPU numerics can shift words slightly.
knobs.notes: default = FluidAudio's power-efficient default (the shipped path); cpu_and_gpu/all map to MLComputeUnits. Read by the app's ParakeetEngine and by DictationStopBenchmarkRunner (Sources/Dictation/DictationStopBenchmarkRunner.swift:439). CAVEAT for meeting-turnaround: transcripted-cli import-audio loads Parakeet through AsrManager(config: .default) (Tools/TranscriptedCLI/Sources/TranscriptedCLI/TranscribeCommand.swift:246) and never reads this env var, so the meeting-import bench cannot see this knob until the CLI honors it. Shipping a non-default value means changing the production default in ParakeetModelLifecycle, not just an env var.

knobs.title: Speech model for dictation and meetings
knobs.risk: Whisper models are much slower and bigger; v2 is English-only. A bad pick makes dictation feel laggy or drops non-English words.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). The CLI import path is hardwired to Parakeet v3, so meeting-import cannot measure this either.

knobs.title: Load speech and speaker models at launch
knobs.risk: Lazy loading saves idle memory but makes the first dictation or meeting after launch wait for a model load.
knobs.notes: Controlled today by env TRANSCRIPTED_LAZY_MODEL_WARMUP=1, which is INVERTED relative to this knob (true = eager = env unset). Deliberately no env apply entry: the registry encodes true as '1', which would set LAZY=1 and turn warmup OFF. Needs either an inverted apply mode or a positive env name. The stop benches preload the model, so they would not see this anyway.

knobs.title: Minimum confidence to auto-pick a meeting language
knobs.risk: Too low picks the wrong language and garbles a whole meeting; too high falls back to multilingual/uncertain more often.
knobs.notes: Only used by Whisper models (WhisperEngine). With the default Parakeet model this has no effect.

knobs.title: Meeting transcription language
knobs.risk: Forcing a language transcribes other-language speech as nonsense.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). The real setting accepts every code in TranscriptionLanguagePreferences.supportedLanguages; only auto/en are listed here because those are the only values worth benchmarking on an English corpus. Whisper-only.

knobs.title: Dictation stop pipeline variant
knobs.risk: Non-production paths skip parts of the real stop path (recovery checkpoint, persistence snapshot), so a win can be a measurement artifact.
knobs.notes: Only 'production' is what ships. A non-production winner is a lead, not a setting: it means porting that decode path into ParakeetEngine/DictationSessionController and re-benching as production. Note the runner's own fallback when the env var is unset is 'native' (DictationStopBenchmarkRunner.swift:429), so the bench adapter must always set this env var.

knobs.title: Save transcript before or after auto-Enter
knobs.risk: saveAfterAutoEnter can lose the saved dictation if the app dies right after Enter; saveBefore adds disk I/O contention near paste.
knobs.notes: Shipping a change means editing DictationStopFinalizationPolicy.order. Only moves stop_to_delivery when auto-Enter is simulated.

knobs.title: Chunk length for the chunked stop path (seconds)
knobs.risk: Short chunks cut words at chunk seams and raise WER.
knobs.notes: Only matters when dictation.stop.path = chunked; every other path ignores it, so searching it alone on the production path is wasted trials.

knobs.title: Hotkey repeat debounce (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short lets a key bounce start/stop dictation twice; too long swallows a quick second press.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Push-to-talk modifier chord wait (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short fires dictation when the user meant a modifier shortcut; too long adds lag before recording starts.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Recorder readiness poll interval (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too long adds start lag; too short burns main-thread wakeups while waiting on the mic.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Wait before retrying a failed mic start (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short retries before CoreAudio settles and fails again; too long stalls dictation after a device change. Also scales prewarm retry time.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Wait for a new input device to settle (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short records from the old or wrong mic after a switch (Bluetooth especially); too long delays start.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Background mic prewarm retries
knobs.risk: Too few gives up before a slow device settles, so the next press is cold; too many loops on a dead mic.
knobs.notes: Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned. Each retry waits dictation.audio.recovery_delay_s.

knobs.title: Keep the recommended mic open between dictations
knobs.risk: Keeps the mic indicator on all the time and can block other apps' device changes; users see it as always listening.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). Press-side timing: the dictation-stop bench starts from already-recorded audio and does not exercise it. Needs a press-to-recording objective before it can be tuned.

knobs.title: Clean up dictated text before paste
knobs.risk: Turning it off pastes raw filler words and spacing; turning it on adds a small post-processing step.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). Default is true when the key is unset.

knobs.title: Wait for the target app to activate before paste (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short falls back to copy-only in apps that activate slowly; too long delays text when activation already failed.
knobs.notes: On the stop-to-text path, but only when the target app is not frontmost.

knobs.title: Wait for the target app to read the clipboard (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short marks slow apps' pastes as unconfirmed (user sees a copy notice for text that did land); too long delays delivery.

knobs.title: Wait before restoring the user's clipboard (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short restores the old clipboard before a slow app finishes reading, so it pastes the wrong thing.
knobs.notes: Moves stop_to_delivery, not stop_to_text. Slow-pasteback smoke (run-slow-pasteback-smoke.sh) must pass after any change.

knobs.title: Pause between paste and auto-Enter (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short presses Enter before the text lands, submitting an empty or partial message.
knobs.notes: Only when auto-Enter is on. Moves stop_to_delivery.

knobs.title: Speaker voiceprint model
knobs.risk: Switching embedders uses a separate speaker database, so every saved voice is forgotten until re-confirmed.
knobs.notes: Also a user setting (UserDefaults key speaker-embedder-preference); the env var wins over it. transcripted-cli reads the same env var (MeetingImportWorkflow.swift:218). Not listed for speaker-naming-across-calls: autoeval replays fixed fingerprints, so the embedder is baked into the fingerprint cache, not applied per trial.

knobs.title: Similarity needed to name a returning speaker silently
knobs.risk: Too low silently puts the wrong person's name on a transcript; too high keeps asking about people it knows.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. Invariant: must stay >= EmbeddingClusterer.sameVoiceConsolidationThreshold (0.88), pinned by testConsolidationThresholdNotAboveAutoAcceptBar.

knobs.title: Lead over the next-closest person needed to auto-name
knobs.risk: Too low names the wrong one of two similar-sounding people; this margin is the main guard on compressed call audio.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: Confirmed meetings before a person can be auto-named
knobs.risk: Too low trusts a voiceprint built from one or two meetings and mislabels; too high means users confirm the same person for weeks.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: What counts toward auto-name maturity
knobs.risk: appearances lets passive, never-confirmed matches graduate a profile, so one early mistake can become a silent auto-name.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. The app counts profile.confirmedMeetingCount; 'appearances' would need a different counter in isAutoRecognizable.

knobs.title: What counts toward match maturity (immature-profile bonus)
knobs.risk: confirmed_meetings keeps the stricter immature-profile bar longer, so fewer suggestions for people the user never confirms.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. The app keys the maturity bonus on profile.callCount (appearances).

knobs.title: Shift on the cross-call match floors
knobs.risk: Negative matches more strangers to known profiles (wrong suggestions, contaminated voiceprints); positive asks about known people more.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. The app has no offset: shipping a winner means shifting the three WeSpeaker adaptive match floors (speaker.match.adaptive_*.wespeaker) by this amount. The harness only applies it to WeSpeaker floors.

knobs.title: Extra auto-name gate on similarity to the profile average
knobs.risk: Too high blocks auto-naming for people whose voice varies across mics; too low adds nothing over the best-exemplar gate.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. -1.0 means off (the shipped behavior; the app has no such gate). Modeled as an enum of numbers, not a float, because the only meaningful values are 'off' or roughly 0.80-0.92: a stepped float starting at -1 would crawl through a dead zone where every value behaves like off, and the climber would never reach the useful range. Choices match scripts/speaker_autoresearch_contract.py one_knob_grid. The value is sent to the bench as a JSON number.

knobs.title: Minimum speech in a meeting before auto-naming
knobs.risk: Too high never auto-names people who only say a few words; 0 lets a two-second 'yeah' be silently named.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. 0 = off (shipped). The app has no such gate yet; a winner means adding it to shouldAutoAccept.

knobs.title: Minimum speaking turns before auto-naming
knobs.risk: Too high skips auto-naming for quiet participants; 0 trusts a voiceprint from one turn.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. 0 = off (shipped). The app has no such gate yet; a winner means adding it to shouldAutoAccept.

knobs.title: Which matches may update a stored voiceprint
knobs.risk: production lets unconfirmed suggestions drift a voiceprint; confirmed_only can leave voiceprints stale as voices or mics change.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. 'production' = every accepted DB match may blend (voiceprintBlendAlpha gate only).

knobs.title: Lead over runner-up needed to update a voiceprint
knobs.risk: Too low blends ambiguous matches into the wrong person's voiceprint, which compounds across meetings.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: Similarity for full-rate voiceprint update
knobs.risk: Too low adapts fast on weak matches (drift); too high freezes profiles so they fall behind real voice drift.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. Keep >= speaker.writeback.cautious_similarity; the harness does not enforce the ordering.

knobs.title: Similarity for slow-rate voiceprint update (below = frozen)
knobs.risk: Too low lets mediocre matches nudge the voiceprint; too high freezes most real-world matches.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. Keep <= speaker.writeback.confident_similarity.

knobs.title: Voiceprint update weight for confident matches
knobs.risk: Too high lets one meeting overwrite a voiceprint; 0 freezes profiles entirely.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. Keep >= speaker.writeback.cautious_blend_alpha.

knobs.title: Voiceprint update weight for cautious matches
knobs.risk: Too high lets borderline matches drift a voiceprint.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check. Keep <= speaker.writeback.confident_blend_alpha.

knobs.title: Extra voiceprints stored per person
knobs.risk: Too many lets a stray condition (or a different person) earn its own slot and match strangers; too few loses the clean-vs-call split.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: Similarity at which a new sample folds into an existing voiceprint
knobs.risk: Too low folds different mic conditions together; too high fills slots with near-duplicates.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: Update weight when folding a sample into its voiceprint
knobs.risk: Too high lets one meeting rewrite a condition's voiceprint.
knobs.notes: Tunable per trial in SpeakerEvalHarness autoeval (AutoResearchConfig); hardcoded in the app, so a winner means editing the source constant and re-running the harness's productionBaseline check.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 1 speaking turn (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low matches strangers to saved people on one short turn; too high never recognizes quiet speakers.
knobs.notes: Match floor in TranscriptionPipeline via adaptiveMatch(forSegmentCount:). The autoeval harness reads SpeakerEmbeddingThresholds.weSpeaker directly (AutoResearch.swift:243), so speaker.naming.match_floor_offset is the bench-only proxy for moving this.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 1 speaking turn (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low matches strangers to saved people on one short turn; too high never recognizes quiet speakers.
knobs.notes: Match floor in TranscriptionPipeline via adaptiveMatch(forSegmentCount:). Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 2-3 turns (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low attaches strangers to saved profiles and contaminates them; too high loses returning people.
knobs.notes: The autoeval harness reads SpeakerEmbeddingThresholds.weSpeaker directly (AutoResearch.swift:243), so speaker.naming.match_floor_offset is the bench-only proxy for moving this.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 2-3 turns (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low attaches strangers to saved profiles and contaminates them; too high loses returning people.
knobs.notes: Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 4+ turns (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low attaches strangers to saved profiles and contaminates them; too high loses returning people.
knobs.notes: The autoeval harness reads SpeakerEmbeddingThresholds.weSpeaker directly (AutoResearch.swift:243), so speaker.naming.match_floor_offset is the bench-only proxy for moving this.

knobs.title: Cross-call match floor, 4+ turns (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low attaches strangers to saved profiles and contaminates them; too high loses returning people.
knobs.notes: Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Floor for folding a low-quality ghost speaker into a real one (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low folds a real quiet participant into someone else; too high leaves phantom speakers in the transcript.
knobs.notes: Used at TranscriptionPipeline.swift:372 and :1187.

knobs.title: Floor for folding a low-quality ghost speaker into a real one (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low folds a real quiet participant into someone else; too high leaves phantom speakers in the transcript.
knobs.notes: Used at TranscriptionPipeline.swift:372 and :1187. Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Same-voice cluster merge within a meeting (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low merges two people into one speaker row; too high splits one person into several.
knobs.notes: WeSpeaker invariant: must stay <= speaker.naming.auto_similarity (0.92), pinned by a test. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Same-voice cluster merge within a meeting (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low merges two people into one speaker row; too high splits one person into several.
knobs.notes: WeSpeaker invariant: must stay <= speaker.naming.auto_similarity (0.92), pinned by a test. Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Absorb a small cluster (<30s) into a large one (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low absorbs a real short-speaking participant into someone else; too high leaves fragment speakers.
knobs.notes: Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Absorb a small cluster (<30s) into a large one (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low absorbs a real short-speaking participant into someone else; too high leaves fragment speakers.
knobs.notes: Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Absorb a micro cluster (<10s) (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low hides a brief real participant; too high leaves many one-line phantom speakers.

knobs.title: Absorb a micro cluster (<10s) (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low hides a brief real participant; too high leaves many one-line phantom speakers.
knobs.notes: Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Per-turn match floor for splitting a mixed cluster by saved voices (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too low splits one person into two known names; too high leaves two known people merged.

knobs.title: Per-turn match floor for splitting a mixed cluster by saved voices (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too low splits one person into two known names; too high leaves two known people merged.
knobs.notes: Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Guard that stops merging clusters that look like different known people (WeSpeaker)
knobs.risk: Too high merges two known people during consolidation; too low blocks legitimate merges.
knobs.notes: EmbeddingClusterer.knownProfileConflictThreshold (EmbeddingClusterer.swift:44) mirrors the WeSpeaker value as a default argument.

knobs.title: Guard that stops merging clusters that look like different known people (ERes2Net)
knobs.risk: Too high merges two known people during consolidation; too low blocks legitimate merges.
knobs.notes: EmbeddingClusterer.knownProfileConflictThreshold (EmbeddingClusterer.swift:44) mirrors the WeSpeaker value as a default argument. Only active when speaker.embedder = eres2net.

knobs.title: Speech below which a cluster counts as small (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high absorbs real participants who spoke less than this; too low leaves fragment speakers.

knobs.title: Speech below which a cluster counts as micro (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high applies the loose micro-absorb bar to real short speakers.

knobs.title: Turns per saved voice needed to split a mixed cluster
knobs.risk: Too low splits clusters on noise; too high never separates two known people the diarizer merged.

knobs.title: Extra similarity needed for profiles seen in 1-2 meetings
knobs.risk: Too low lets a fresh, noisy profile grab strangers; too high means new people are not recognized on their second call.
knobs.notes: The autoeval harness runs this code (Transcription.matchAgainstProfiles), so it moves speaker-naming-across-calls, but the value is compiled in.

knobs.title: Extra similarity needed for profiles seen in 3-4 meetings
knobs.risk: Same trade-off as maturity_bonus_new, smaller.
knobs.notes: Compiled into the matcher the harness uses.

knobs.title: Minimum gap between top two profiles to accept a match
knobs.risk: Too low picks one of two near-identical profiles at random; too high drops matches whenever two family members are saved.
knobs.notes: Compiled into the matcher the harness uses.

knobs.title: Similarity for fusing two clusters that matched one person
knobs.risk: Too low fuses two different people into one named row; too high leaves one person split across two rows.
knobs.notes: Not per-embedder today (same 0.78 for ERes2Net). The harness mirrors the production collision planner.

knobs.title: Similarity to a rejected sample that vetoes a match
knobs.risk: Too low vetoes the real owner after one correction; too high keeps re-suggesting someone the user already rejected.
knobs.notes: Not per-embedder today.

knobs.title: How far rejected samples are projected across mic conditions
knobs.risk: Too high vetoes the real owner on degraded audio; 0 loses cross-condition veto coverage.

knobs.title: Similarity at which two saved profiles auto-merge after a meeting
knobs.risk: Too low permanently fuses two different people's saved profiles (hard to undo); too high leaves duplicates for the user to clean up.
knobs.notes: Called from TranscriptionPipelineRunner.swift:518 with the default. Same 0.6 for both embedders, which is loose for WeSpeaker (different-speaker p95 cosine ~0.62 per SpeakerEmbeddingThresholds.swift:11); worth a look. shouldSkipDuplicateMerge protects some profiles. Not exercised by autoeval (fixed fingerprints, no duplicate-merge pass).

knobs.title: Diarizer clustering threshold
knobs.risk: Too low merges different people; too high splits one person into several speakers.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: VBx Fa (acoustic scaling)
knobs.risk: Mis-tuned VBx reassigns turns to the wrong speaker; the grid found Fa is the biggest DER lever.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: VBx Fb (speaker regularization)
knobs.risk: Too low over-splits speakers; too high collapses them.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Segmentation window (seconds)
knobs.risk: The PyAnnote segmentation model is trained on 10s windows; shorter windows usually hurt accuracy.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Segmentation window step ratio
knobs.risk: Larger steps are faster but miss short turns; smaller steps cost time.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Speaker embedding batch size
knobs.risk: Bigger batches use more memory; too small is slower. Should not change results.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Minimum speech segment (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high drops short replies like 'yes'; too low creates noisy one-word speakers.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench. Live through LabKnobOverrides (Sources/TranscriptedCore/Utilities/LabKnobOverrides.swift): the bench writes the request value into the JSON file named by TRANSCRIPTED_LAB_KNOBS_FILE under this exact id; the app and transcripted-cli read it once per process. Shipping a winner still means changing the default in source.

knobs.title: Minimum gap between segments (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high glues two people's turns together; too low chops one turn into fragments.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Speech onset threshold
knobs.risk: Too low marks noise as speech; too high misses quiet speech starts.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Speech offset threshold
knobs.risk: Too low ends turns early; too high runs turns into silence.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Segmentation min speech duration (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high drops short utterances before clustering.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Segmentation min silence duration (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high bridges real pauses between speakers.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Max VBx iterations
knobs.risk: Too few stops VBx before it converges (worse speaker assignment); more costs time on long meetings.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: VBx convergence tolerance
knobs.risk: Looser tolerance is faster but can stop VBx early.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Exclude overlapped speech from voiceprints
knobs.risk: Including overlap blends two voices into one embedding and causes false merges.
knobs.notes: From the v2 DER grid search (16 Zoom meetings). transcripted-cli import-audio uses this same DiarizationService, so a seam here would be visible to the meeting-import bench.

knobs.title: Minimum segment quality to use for a voiceprint
knobs.risk: Too low lets noisy turns pull voiceprints off; too high leaves quiet speakers with no voiceprint (unnamed).
knobs.notes: Affects cross-call naming in real use, but autoeval replays fingerprints already computed, so only meeting-import sees it.

knobs.title: Minimum turn length to use for a voiceprint (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too low builds voiceprints from fragments; too high leaves people who speak in short bursts without a voiceprint.

knobs.title: Join same-speaker lines separated by less than this (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high glues separate thoughts into walls of text; too low produces choppy one-line transcript rows.
knobs.notes: Same literal at TranscriptionPipeline.swift:736, :848 and :929; a seam must change all four.

knobs.title: Longest joined transcript line (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high produces huge unreadable paragraphs; too low splits long monologues mid-thought.

knobs.title: Silence that splits the mic track into segments (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too low chops words mid-phrase for STT; too high sends long segments with more latency and hallucination risk.
knobs.notes: Mic channel only (live capture). The meeting-import bench runs imports as system audio and does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Shortest mic segment sent to STT (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too high drops short replies like 'yes'; too low sends clicks and breaths to STT.
knobs.notes: Mic channel only (live capture); not exercised by meeting-import.

knobs.title: Separate multiple people sharing the room mic
knobs.risk: Turning it on runs a second diarization pass (slower) and can split the owner into several 'You' speakers.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). Default false (UserDefaults.bool on a missing key). Live-capture mic path only.

knobs.title: Lowest adaptive speech-detect level
knobs.risk: Too low treats room noise as speech (hallucinated words); too high drops quiet WebRTC-attenuated mics.
knobs.notes: Same clamp literal at AudioSignalRecovery.swift:186; change both. Live mic capture path; the meeting-import bench does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Highest adaptive speech-detect level
knobs.risk: Too low lets loud background noise pass as speech; too high misses normal-level speech on hot mics.
knobs.notes: Same clamp literal at AudioSignalRecovery.swift:186; change both. Live mic capture path; the meeting-import bench does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Peak level quiet mic audio is lifted to before STT
knobs.risk: Too high clips loud audio after gain; too low leaves quiet mics under-recognized.
knobs.notes: Default argument also at AudioSignalRecovery.swift:167 (normalizationGain); change both. Used for mic STT and mic diarization input.

knobs.title: Maximum gain for quiet mic audio before STT
knobs.risk: Too high amplifies noise into hallucinated words; too low cannot rescue WebRTC-attenuated mics (issue #500).
knobs.notes: Default argument also at AudioSignalRecovery.swift:168; change both.

knobs.title: Live mic autogain target peak
knobs.risk: Too high clips the saved mic track; too low leaves quiet mics quiet. Runs inside the CoreAudio tap: a seam must read the value outside the real-time callback.
knobs.notes: Only when meeting.mic.processing_mode = software_agc. Live mic capture path; the meeting-import bench does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Live mic autogain maximum gain
knobs.risk: Too high pumps room noise during silence into the saved mic track; too low cannot lift attenuated WebRTC mics.
knobs.notes: Only when meeting.mic.processing_mode = software_agc. Live mic capture path; the meeting-import bench does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Meeting mic processing
knobs.risk: apple_voice_processing ducks other apps' audio during calls; none leaves quiet WebRTC mics near-silent.
knobs.notes: Real user setting stored in UserDefaults under the apply key. No bench writes UserDefaults yet, so this stays needs-seam until one does (a bench would need its own defaults domain so it never touches the user's settings). Falls back to the legacy meeting-mic-voice-processing-enabled bool when the mode key is unset. Live mic capture path; the meeting-import bench does not exercise it.

knobs.title: Base wait for capture files to close after Stop (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short fails meetings whose audio was still flushing (user sees a failed meeting); too long delays failure reporting.
knobs.notes: A failure ceiling, not a speed knob: lowering it does not make healthy stops faster. Scaled by the next two knobs for 1h+ recordings.

knobs.title: Extra file-close wait per recorded hour (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short fails long meetings during finalization.
knobs.notes: Failure ceiling, see meeting.stop.file_close_timeout_s.

knobs.title: Cap on the file-close wait (seconds)
knobs.risk: Too short fails 2h+ meetings; must stay below meetingTerminationFinishWaitTimeout (145s, TranscriptedConstants.swift:133).
knobs.notes: Failure ceiling. Hard upper bound 145s because quit-time preservation waits at most that long.

knobs.title: Resampler read chunk (seconds)
knobs.risk: Bigger chunks use more memory on long meetings; tiny chunks add per-read overhead.
knobs.notes: Throughput only; should not change transcript content.

knobs.title: Mic recording merge chunk (seconds)
knobs.risk: Bigger chunks use more memory; tiny chunks slow the stop-time merge on long meetings.
knobs.notes: chunkSize at MicRecordingFileMerger.swift:34 is a separate literal (16_000 * 30) that must move with it. Live capture stop only.
